dedupe_keys.name: synthetic european road freight transport flow data based on etisplus

description: This dataset gives estimated European truck traffic flows between 1,675 regions and assigns them to the European highway network, so that each road section carries a synthetic truck volume. It updates the truck results of the ETISplus project (2010) with Eurostat growth rates to 2019, adds a 2030 forecast that assumes the same growth, converts freight tonnes to vehicle trips with an average load of 13.6 t and 25% empty trips, and routes the trips with Dijkstra shortest paths in NetworkX. The four CSV files hold 1,514,573 directed origin-destination flows with their shortest paths and distances, the NUTS-3 regions, network nodes and network edges with truck counts for 2019 and 2030. It was produced by Daniel Speth, Verena Sauter and Patrick Plötz (Fraunhofer ISI) and Tim Signer (KIT). Coverage is Europe at NUTS-3 level. Access: free download from Mendeley Data under CC BY 4.0 (version 2); a third-party copy is also on Kaggle. Caveats: the flows are modelled, not observed; intra-regional traffic is excluded; and the authors note that some edge paths are listed from destination to origin. It supports network flow modelling of road freight, charging infrastructure planning for electric trucks and corridor disruption studies, and complements the European truck parking locations and the long-haul truck charging trip chains catalogued here.
